AccessTokenRead.description:
An access token for `Authorization: Bearer`, valid 15 minutes (ADR-006).

The SPA keeps it in memory only; the refresh token comes as a cookie.
AccessTokenRead.title: AccessTokenRead

BackToSetupWrite.description: Back to setup, from the state the screen showed (FR-036, ADR-008).
BackToSetupWrite.title: BackToSetupWrite

BracketMatchRead.description:
A bracket match with its sides derived from the results (D4).

`number` counts the tournament's matches, the group phase's first; a bye
has none (BR-041). `state`: `bye`; `played`; `on_field`; `ready` (both
sides known, no field); `waiting` (a side still to come). `score` is
side 1's: a BO1 game's goals, else the games won; null before a result
or for a walkover. `next_number` is the match the winner plays next.
`result_locked` says a later match it feeds has a result, so this one
cannot change until that is cleared (BR-094).
BracketMatchRead.title: BracketMatchRead

BracketRead.description:
The knockout, computed on read (D4, screens 9 and 10).

`size` is the smallest power of two that fits the entries (BR-040). The
final plays `final_match_format`, or `match_format` when it is null
(BR-120).
BracketRead.title: BracketRead

BracketRoundRead.description: A round of the bracket; the last holds the final and the third-place match.
BracketRoundRead.title: BracketRoundRead

BracketSideRead.description:
A side: the entry and its knockout seed, a bye, or null while to come.

`decided_by_lot` says a lot placed the entry among those level with it in
the group phase, or took it through the cut (BR-074, ADR-009).
BracketSideRead.title: BracketSideRead

BusyFieldRead.description: A field holding players of a waiting match: why it waits (BR-131).
BusyFieldRead.title: BusyFieldRead

DefaultMatchFormat.description:
The match format a league's new tournaments start with (FR-011, BR-120).

Not BO2: only group phases of leagues with draws can play it (BR-121), so a
default that a knockout cannot take is never copied (DATA-MODEL §4.2).
DefaultMatchFormat.title: DefaultMatchFormat

DrawTarget.description: What "draw again" draws: the pairs (DYP, Doubles) or the seeds (shuffle).
DrawTarget.title: DrawTarget

DrawWrite.description: A new draw, with the draw counter the screen showed (ADR-008, ADR-010).
DrawWrite.title: DrawWrite

DypHalf.description: Where a DYP player stands before the draw (DATA-MODEL `dyp_halves.half`).
DypHalf.title: DypHalf

EntryKind.description: An entry is one player or a pair (glossary "Entry", BR-030).
EntryKind.title: EntryKind

EntryRead.description:
An entry: one player, or a pair with its better-ranked player first.

A DYP pair names its top-half player first. `seed` is null in Monster DYP.
EntryRead.title: EntryRead

EntryStage.description: Which phase an entry plays: the first (`main`) or a later knockout (D4).
EntryStage.title: EntryStage

ErrorCode.description: Every stable error code of the API (ADR-008).
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

ErrorResponse.description: The body of every error response (ADR-008).
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

FieldCreate.description:
A new field, with the number it expects to get: the lowest free one (BR-132).

The number is the expectation of ADR-008, so a repeat gets 409 instead of
a second field.
FieldCreate.title: FieldCreate

FieldRead.description: A field and the match being played on it, null while it is free (D10).
FieldRead.title: FieldRead

FinishWrite.description: Finish the tournament, from the state the screen showed (FR-040, ADR-008).
FinishWrite.title: FinishWrite

FormResult.description: One result in an entry's form, from the entry's side.
FormResult.title: FormResult

GameRead.description: One game of a result: its winner and, if entered, its score (D11).
GameRead.title: GameRead

GameWrite.description:
One game: its winner and both scores, or neither (FR-050, FR-051, BR-092).

Goals per game is a guide, not a rule: any whole number is a score (BR-123).
GameWrite.title: GameWrite

GroupPhase.description:
The group phase chosen in setup, or none (FR-031).

Monster DYP always plays `monster_dyp`, and the other types never do.
GroupPhase.title: GroupPhase

HalvesMethod.description: How a DYP tournament's halves are made (FR-033, BR-032).
HalvesMethod.title: HalvesMethod

HalvesWrite.description:
How a DYP tournament's halves are made (FR-033, BR-032).

`ranking` ignores `halves`. `by_hand` sets them as the target state; a
picked player without a row has no half yet.
HalvesWrite.title: HalvesWrite

KnockoutMatchFormat.description: A match format a knockout and its final can play: never BO2 (BR-121).
KnockoutMatchFormat.title: KnockoutMatchFormat

KnockoutPreviewEntryRead.description: A knockout entry by seed; `decided_by_lot` marks a lot's work (BR-074).
KnockoutPreviewEntryRead.title: KnockoutPreviewEntryRead

KnockoutPreviewMemberRead.description: A group-phase entry behind a knockout entry, with its group-phase place.
KnockoutPreviewMemberRead.title: KnockoutPreviewMemberRead

KnockoutPreviewRead.description:
What starting the knockout would draw, writing nothing (FR-045, BR-080).

`can_start` is false exactly when `problem` is set: the code and detail
of the error `PUT …/knockout` would answer. `qualifiers` is the number
asked for, kept between the fewest a knockout takes (2, or 4 with a
third-place match) and `max_qualifiers`, the entries that can go through;
when fewer than the fewest can, `entries` is empty. `first_round` pairs
the seeds of each first-round match, null for a bye (BR-041), top of the
bracket first. `locks_round_no` is the last group round, whose results
the draw locks (BR-053). `is_cut_by_lot` says the cut fell inside a
shared place, so the lot chose who goes through (BR-074).
KnockoutPreviewRead.title: KnockoutPreviewRead

KnockoutProblemRead.description: Why starting the knockout would be refused: the error's code and detail.
KnockoutProblemRead.title: KnockoutProblemRead

KnockoutWrite.description:
Draw the knockout and start it (FR-045, BR-080, BR-120).

`expected_current_phase_id` is the phase the screen saw as current, the
group phase (ADR-008). `expected_qualifier_ids` are the group-phase
entries the preview showed going through, in seed order (`entries` of the
preview, by their members' `entry_id`): a group result that changed the cut
or the seeds since is 409 `qualifiers_changed`. `match_format` null takes
the league's default; `final_match_format` null lets the final play
`match_format` (BR-120).
BO2 is never a knockout's (BR-121). `mode` is how the teams are formed
after Monster DYP rounds (BR-081 to BR-084) and null after any other
group phase; a mode after a round robin is 422
`knockout_mode_not_applicable`.
KnockoutWrite.title: KnockoutWrite

Language.description: The UI language an account remembers (FR-081, DATA-MODEL §4.1).
Language.title: Language

LeagueCreate.description: A new league; `id` is generated by the client (ADR-008).
LeagueCreate.title: LeagueCreate

LeagueRead.description:
A league as its organizer sees it, with every season, oldest first.

`share_token` is the secret of the league's share link (FR-070, FR-071).
LeagueRead.title: LeagueRead

LeagueSummary.description: A league in the organizer's list (FR-007).
LeagueSummary.title: LeagueSummary

LeagueUpdate.description:
League settings to change (FR-011); a field left out or null stays as it is.

Each value is the target state, so repeating the request changes nothing
(ADR-008). The placement points table belongs to the season: see
`set_placement_points`.
LeagueUpdate.title: LeagueUpdate

LoginRequest.description: An email and a password; `throttle_login` reads it too (ADR-006).
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

MatchFormat.description: Best of how many games a match is (BR-120); BO2 only in group phases (BR-121).
MatchFormat.title: MatchFormat

MatchKind.description: A bracket has one third-place match; every other match is standard (BR-044).
MatchKind.title: MatchKind

MatchRead.description: A match with its two sides and its result; no result yet is null (D11).
MatchRead.title: MatchRead

MatchSideRead.description:
A side: its entry (null for a Monster DYP team or a bye) and its players.

A pair's players come in the entry's order.
MatchSideRead.title: MatchSideRead

MonsterKnockoutMode.description: How the knockout after Monster DYP rounds is formed (FR-045, BR-081 to BR-084).
MonsterKnockoutMode.title: MonsterKnockoutMode

OrganizerRead.description: An account in the admin's list.
OrganizerRead.title: OrganizerRead

Outcome.description: A match's result, or a game's winner: one side, or a draw (BR-090, D11).
Outcome.title: Outcome

PairsWrite.description:
A Doubles tournament's pairs, the target state (FR-033, BR-003, BR-030).

No player twice (`given_twice`); picked players left out have no partner yet.
PairsWrite.title: PairsWrite

PasswordChange.description: The current password and the new one (FR-004).
PasswordChange.title: PasswordChange

PasswordReset.description: A temporary password the admin chose, or null to have one generated.
PasswordReset.title: PasswordReset

PasswordResetRead.description: The generated temporary password, shown once; null if the admin chose one.
PasswordResetRead.title: PasswordResetRead

PhaseFormat.description: How a phase is played: one of the group formats, or the knockout's.
PhaseFormat.title: PhaseFormat

PhaseKind.description: A phase is a group phase or a knockout (DATA-MODEL §4.3, D9).
PhaseKind.title: PhaseKind

PhaseRead.description: A phase with every setting; those that do not apply are null (FR-031).
PhaseRead.title: PhaseRead

PlaceRead.description:
An entry's final place and the season points each of its players earns.

Entries sharing a place get the average of the places they cover,
rounded down; places beyond the season's table earn 0 (BR-110, BR-111).
PlaceRead.title: PlaceRead

PlaceReasonRead.description:
Why an entry has its place (§7.13).

An entry that did not go through to the knockout, or every entry of a
group phase without one, has `group_place`: its place in the standings
and the phase's format (BR-103). A knockout entry has the final, the
third-place match or `lost_in_round` with the `round` it went out in, the
`score` of that match (the entry's first: a BO1 game's goals, else the
games won; null for a walkover or a game without a score) and the
opponent (BR-102); its `group_place` is that of the entry it continues.
PlaceReasonRead.title: PlaceReasonRead

PlacementPointsUpdate.description: The whole placement points table, first place first (FR-011).
PlacementPointsUpdate.title: PlacementPointsUpdate

PlacementWrite.description:
A match on a field, or back to waiting when `field_id` is null (FR-093).

`from_field_id` is the field the screen saw the match on, null when it
saw it waiting. A match that is elsewhere now is 409 `placement_changed`.
PlacementWrite.title: PlacementWrite

PlacementsWrite.description:
Where matches are to be played, the target state (FR-093, ADR-008).

One placement puts a waiting match on a free field, moves a match to a
free field, or sends it back to waiting. A swap is two placements: both
matches, on fields, with each other's field. Nothing else is allowed
(422 `placement_not_allowed`). A match or a field named twice is 422
`validation_failed` (`given_twice`).
PlacementsWrite.title: PlacementsWrite

PlacesRead.description:
The places of a tournament (§7.13, §7.14), computed on read (D1).

`complete` is true once the tournament is finished; before that `rows` is
empty. Rows come best place first.
PlacesRead.title: PlacesRead

PlayRead.description:
The running group phase, computed on read (ADR-009, FR-060, FR-092).

`waiting` is the waiting list: requeued matches first, then schedule order
(BR-130, BR-132). `standings` are the round robin's, best first; other
group formats have none yet. `group_done` says every group-phase match has
a result, so the organizer chooses: knockout or finish (FR-040).
PlayRead.title: PlayRead

PlayStandingRow.description:
One entry's line in the group-phase standings (BR-101, FR-060).

`place` is shared by entries still level (BR-074), and the next place
skips (BR-104). In Swiss and Monster DYP, `points` include the sit-out
points of every round sat out, as soon as the round is drawn (BR-076); a
round robin gives none (BR-071). `form` lists the latest five
results, oldest first. `ahead_by` names what ranks the entry above the
next one when both have the same points, and is null when the points
decide or the place is shared. `bh1` and `bh2` are for Swiss and Monster
DYP, null in a round robin.
PlayStandingRow.title: PlayStandingRow

PlayerCreate.description: A name to add to the league's player list (FR-012).
PlayerCreate.title: PlayerCreate

PlayerRead.description: A player of a league; `removed_at` is null while they are on the list.
PlayerRead.title: PlayerRead

PlayerRemoval.description: Whether the player is removed from the list, the target state (BR-002).
PlayerRemoval.title: PlayerRemoval

PlayerRename.description: A player's new name, the target state (FR-012, ADR-008).
PlayerRename.title: PlayerRename

PlayersWrite.description: The players picked for the tournament, the target state (FR-032).
PlayersWrite.title: PlayersWrite

PreviewMatchRead.description: A match of the preview: the players of each side, a pair in entry order.
PreviewMatchRead.title: PreviewMatchRead

PreviewRoundRead.description: A round of the preview, with the players of each entry that sits it out.
PreviewRoundRead.title: PreviewRoundRead

ProfileUpdate.description: The fields to change; a field left out or null stays as it is.
ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate

PublicBracketMatchRead.description: A bracket match for viewers (FR-072); `result_locked` is the organizer's.
PublicBracketMatchRead.title: PublicBracketMatchRead

PublicBracketRead.description:
The knockout through the share link (FR-070).

A separate allowlist of fields, not a copy of the organizer's bracket: a
field added there must not reach viewers until it is added here on
purpose. Today it holds the same fields, all of which the share link's
tournament already shows or derives from what it shows.
PublicBracketRead.title: PublicBracketRead

PublicBracketSideRead.description: A side for viewers: the entry, its seed and whether a lot decided it, or a bye.
PublicBracketSideRead.title: PublicBracketSideRead

PublicLeagueRead.description:
A league through its share link: name, seasons oldest first, players.

Players come in the order they were added; names sort in the UI's language.
PublicLeagueRead.title: PublicLeagueRead

PublicPlaceRead.description: An entry's final place and the season points each of its players earns.
PublicPlaceRead.title: PublicPlaceRead

PublicPlaceReasonRead.description: Why an entry has its place, for viewers (§7.13): the organizer's reason.
PublicPlaceReasonRead.title: PublicPlaceReasonRead

PublicPlacesRead.description:
The places of a tournament for viewers (FR-070), best place first.

`complete` is true once the tournament is finished; before that `rows` is
empty.
PublicPlacesRead.title: PublicPlacesRead

PublicPlayerRead.description: A player's name for viewers; removed players too, for past results.
PublicPlayerRead.title: PublicPlayerRead

PublicSeasonStandingRow.description:
One player's line in the season standings, for viewers (FR-061, BR-113).

`place` is shared by players level on points and wins, and the next place
skips (BR-104). Removed players stay, with their points (BR-002).
PublicSeasonStandingRow.title: PublicSeasonStandingRow

PublicStandingRow.description:
One entry's line in a round robin's standings, for viewers (FR-060, BR-101).

`place` is shared by entries still level (BR-074), and the next place
skips (BR-104). `points` come from the matches: a round robin gives no
points for sitting out (BR-071). The organizer's extras, the form and what ranks one entry above
the next, are not part of it.
PublicStandingRow.title: PublicStandingRow

PublicTournamentRead.description:
A tournament through the share link: entries, rounds and fields (FR-070).

A separate allowlist of fields, not a copy of the organizer's whole
tournament: a field added to TournamentRead must not reach viewers until it
is added here on purpose. `waiting` lists the matches waiting for a field,
in the order they will get one.
PublicTournamentRead.title: PublicTournamentRead

RankingRow.description: A player's place in the league ranking this tournament uses (BR-020).
RankingRow.title: RankingRow

ResultWrite.description:
A whole result, the target state (ADR-008): every game played, or a walkover.

A walkover names its winner and has no games (FR-052, BR-124). No walkover
and no games is the empty result, which clears the match's result (FR-053).

`expected_sides` are the entries the screen saw on side 1 and side 2. The
sides of a knockout match after the first round are derived from the
winners (DATA-MODEL D4), so "side 1 wins" must name the entry it meant:
it is required there, and optional for a match whose sides are stored.
ResultWrite.title: ResultWrite

RoundName.description: What a bracket round is called, by the entries still in it.
RoundName.title: RoundName

RoundRead.description: A round in play order, with the entries that sit it out (BR-051).
RoundRead.title: RoundRead

RoundRobinTiebreaker.description: What ranks an entry above another level on points (BR-101).
RoundRobinTiebreaker.title: RoundRobinTiebreaker

SchedulePreviewRead.description:
What "Generate and start" would create, or why it would not (FR-035).

`can_start` is false exactly when `problem` is set: the same code and detail
as the 422 of `POST /start` (the 409s of a stale draw counter apart). Then
`rounds` is empty and the counts are null. A round robin lists all its
rounds; `bracket_size` is null until a knockout can start. `draw_counter`
goes back in the start (ADR-008).
SchedulePreviewRead.title: SchedulePreviewRead

SeasonEffectRead.description:
One player's change in the season standings after a tournament (§7.13).

`place` and `points` are those with the tournament; `earned` is what the
player got from it (0 without playing in it); `previous_place` is the place
in the standings of the season's other finished tournaments, null for a
player who played in none of them.
SeasonEffectRead.title: SeasonEffectRead

SeasonRead.description: A season; `name` is null while it has the default name (FR-020).
SeasonRead.title: SeasonRead

SeasonRename.description: A season's new name; null restores the default "Season <number>" (FR-020).
SeasonRename.title: SeasonRename

SeasonStandingRead.description:
One player's line in the season standings (FR-061, BR-113).

`place` is shared by players level on points and wins, and the next place
skips (BR-104). `tournament_wins` counts the finished tournaments in which
the player's entry was 1st, a shared 1st included.
SeasonStandingRead.title: SeasonStandingRead

SeasonStart.description: Start the next season; the active season's number as the client saw it.
SeasonStart.title: SeasonStart

SeasonState.description: Whether a season is the league's active one (FR-021, DATA-MODEL §4.2).
SeasonState.title: SeasonState

SeedOrderWrite.description: Every main entry, seed 1 first: the full order, never a move (ADR-008).
SeedOrderWrite.title: SeedOrderWrite

SeedingMethod.description: How the first phase is seeded (FR-034, BR-021, BR-022).
SeedingMethod.title: SeedingMethod

SeedingWrite.description: Seed by league ranking or by random shuffle (FR-034, BR-021, BR-022).
SeedingWrite.title: SeedingWrite

SignUpRequest.description: A new account and the instance's sign-up code (FR-001); the throttle reads it.
SignUpRequest.title: SignUpRequest

SignupCodeRead.description: The sign-up code, which the admin may see and share; null: sign-up is closed.
SignupCodeRead.title: SignupCodeRead

SignupCodeUpdate.description: The new code, or null to close sign-up (FR-005).
SignupCodeUpdate.title: SignupCodeUpdate

StartProblemRead.description: The refusal "Generate and start" would answer: the 422's code and detail.
StartProblemRead.title: StartProblemRead

StartWrite.description: Generate and start, with the draw counter the review screen showed (ADR-008).
StartWrite.title: StartWrite

Tiebreaker.description: A tie-breaker of a Swiss or Monster DYP phase (FR-043, BR-073).
Tiebreaker.title: Tiebreaker

TournamentCreate.description:
A new tournament in the league's active season (FR-030).

`id` is a UUIDv7 made by the client; a repeat gets the same tournament back
(ADR-008). A setting left out or null takes the league's default: goals per
game, the number of fields and the match format of the phase (FR-011); one
round robin leg, 0 points for sitting out in Swiss and Monster DYP (FR-039)
and no third-place match. A round robin has no points for sitting out
(BR-071): a number there is 422 `sit_out_points_not_applicable`.
TournamentCreate.title: TournamentCreate

TournamentFormatRead.description:
The format as stored; settings that do not apply are null (FR-031).

`sit_out_points` is null for a round robin and without a group phase (BR-071).
TournamentFormatRead.title: TournamentFormatRead

TournamentFormatWrite.description:
The whole format of a tournament in setup, the target state (FR-030, FR-031).

With a group phase (`round_robin`, `swiss`, `monster_dyp`) its settings are
given and the knockout's are null: a knockout after a group phase is set up
when it starts (FR-045). With `none` the knockout's settings are given and
the group phase's are null. `round_robin_legs` is only for a round robin.
A setting that does not apply is 422 `validation_failed` with
`setting_not_applicable`; one that applies and is missing, `setting_missing`.

`sit_out_points` is for a Swiss or Monster DYP group phase (FR-039, BR-071):
0, 1 or 2 is stored as given (BR-075), and null stores the default, 0. A
round robin has none: a number there is 422 `sit_out_points_not_applicable`.
TournamentFormatWrite.title: TournamentFormatWrite

TournamentProgress.description: How far a running tournament is: rounds and matches with results.
TournamentProgress.title: TournamentProgress

TournamentRead.description:
The whole tournament: settings, entries, rounds and fields (FR-035, FR-092).

`current_phase_id` is the last phase with rounds; `current_phase_done` says
whether all its matches so far have results. `waiting` lists the matches
waiting for a field, in the order they will get one, computed on read.
`entries` are all the tournament's entries as setup shows them: the main
entries by seed, then the knockout-stage entries. A tournament in setup has
no rounds.
TournamentRead.title: TournamentRead

TournamentSetupRead.description:
What the setup screens show (FR-030 to FR-034).

`draw_counter` goes back in "draw again" (ADR-008). `player_ids` are the
picked players in league-ranking order; `ranking` lists every player on the
league's list. `entries` are the main entries by seed.
TournamentSetupRead.title: TournamentSetupRead

TournamentState.description: Where a tournament is in its life (ADR-009, DATA-MODEL §4.3).
TournamentState.title: TournamentState

TournamentSummary.description:
A tournament in its season's list (screen 1).

`player_count` counts the picked players in setup, and the players in the
entries afterwards. `current_phase_id` and `progress` are null, and
`winner_player_ids` too, until the tournament is generated and finished.
TournamentSummary.title: TournamentSummary

WaitingMatchRead.description: A match waiting for a field, in the order it will get one (FR-092).
WaitingMatchRead.title: WaitingMatchRead

get.description: Every account by email, admins included (ADR-007); not cached.

post.description:
Give an organizer a temporary password (FR-006, ADR-006).

Every login of the account is revoked and its next login must choose a new
password. With no `temporary_password` a random one is generated and returned
once. 422 `own_account` for the admin's own account, 422 `admin_target` for
another admin's (the CLI handles admins); 404 `user_not_found`.

get.description: The current sign-up code, or null while sign-up is closed (FR-005).

put.description:
Set or change the code, or close sign-up with null (FR-005).

Existing accounts are not affected. The action is recorded without the code.

post.description: Make a random code, store it and return it (FR-005).

Log in with email and password and start a login on this device.

A wrong password and an unknown email get the same 401. After repeated
failures, an attempt within a growing waiting period gets 429 with
`Retry-After`; nothing is locked.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next attempt is checked.

post.description: End this device's login and remove the cookie; repeating it is harmless.

Change the password and log out every other device (FR-004, ADR-006).

Works while an admin reset requires a new password, and then ends that
requirement. The login this call came from stays. 422 `wrong_password` is a
wrong current password; 422 `password_unchanged` a new one equal to it. The
current password is checked on the login's budget: after repeated failures,
here or at login, an attempt within a growing waiting period gets 429 with
`Retry-After`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next attempt is checked.

post.description:
Exchange the refresh cookie for a new access token and a new cookie.

A 401 means: log in again.

Create an organizer's account with the instance's sign-up code, logged in.

422 `invalid_signup_code` means a wrong code or closed sign-up; 422
`email_taken` an email that has an account, in any letter case. After
repeated failures an attempt within a growing waiting period gets 429 with
`Retry-After`. The tokens are those of a login.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next attempt is checked.

get.description: List the organizer's own leagues, oldest first (FR-007).

post.description:
Create a league with its Season 1, or return it again on a repeat (FR-010).

An id of another organizer's league, or a repeat racing its first attempt,
is 409: reload.

delete.description:
Delete the league with all its seasons (FR-013).

The UI asks for confirmation first. A repeated delete gets 404, which means
the league is already gone.

get.description: Return one of the organizer's leagues; another organizer's is 404.

patch.description: Change the league's settings (FR-011); allowed in any season (BR-011).

get.description:
List the league's players in the order they were added (FR-012).

Removed players come only with `include_removed=true`. Players belong to the
league, so closed seasons need nothing special.

post.description:
Add a player to the league (FR-012).

A name that another player has, in any case, is 422 `player_name_taken`
with the holder's `player_id`, `name` and `removed` (BR-001). When the
holder is removed, the UI asks whether it is the same person and restores
them (ADR-002). A parallel add of the same name that wins the race to the
unique index makes this one 409 `player_name_taken`: reload. A league holds at
most 500 players, removed ones included: more is 422 `player_limit_reached`.

put.description:
Rename a player; the new name shows in past results too (FR-012).

422 `player_name_taken` as for an add, 409 for the race. A removed player can
be renamed too, and the new name must be free as well (BR-011).

Remove a player from the list, or restore them (FR-012, BR-002).

A removal keeps the player, their name and their history; a restored player
is the same player. Both are target states, so repeating one changes nothing.

post.description:
Close the active season and start the next one (FR-021).

409 `season_number_changed`, with the active season's `current_number`,
when `expected_current_number` is stale, for example on a repeat: reload.

put.description: Rename a season, closed ones too (FR-020, BR-011).

Replace the active season's placement points table (FR-011, BR-012).

A closed season keeps its table: 409 `season_closed`, reload (BR-011). A
table with a place worth more than the place above it is 422
`validation_failed` with the error type `placement_points_increase` and the
`place`.

get.description:
Return the season's standings: every player of a finished tournament (FR-061).

Total placement points, then tournament wins; players still level share
the place (BR-113). Only finished tournaments count (BR-112), and removed
players stay (BR-002). A closed season is read with the table it was
played under. Another league's season is 404 `season_not_found`.

List a season's tournaments, newest date first; closed seasons too (FR-022).

Another league's season is 404 `season_not_found`.

post.description:
Create a tournament in setup in the league's active season (FR-030).

A repeat gets the tournament back. An id that another tournament has, in
another season or with another type, is 409 `tournament_id_taken`. BO2 in a
league without draws is 422 `draws_not_allowed` (BR-121). Points for sitting
out in a round robin are 422 `sit_out_points_not_applicable` (BR-071).

get.description:
Return the whole tournament with its rounds and fields (FR-035, FR-092).

Another league's tournament is 404 `tournament_not_found`.

post.description:
Take a started tournament back to setup until the first result (FR-036).

A tournament that is not in progress is 409 `tournament_not_in_progress`;
one with a result is 422 `tournament_has_results`. The schedule goes; the
entries, seeds and draws stay.

get.description:
Return the knockout with its sides derived from the results (D4).

A tournament without a knockout is 404 `knockout_not_found`.

post.description:
Add a field while the tournament runs (FR-090, BR-132).

The body carries the number the field expects to get, the lowest free
one. The new field takes the next waiting match at once; `match_id` is
null when no waiting match can be played.

A tournament in setup or finished is 409 `tournament_not_in_progress`
(detail `state`); setup sets the number of fields with the format. Any
other number, a repeat included, is 409 `field_number_changed` with the
`number` a new field would get now, null when all 32 are taken.

put.description:
Place, move, swap or take off matches by hand (FR-093, BR-133).

Each named match ends on its named field, or waiting, from the field the
screen saw it on (`from_field_id`). A placement by hand holds until the
match has a result. A field a match leaves takes the next waiting match,
but not one this request sends back to waiting, which waits in schedule
order. Returns the whole
tournament with its fields and waiting list.

An unknown match is 404 `match_not_found`, an unknown field 404
`field_not_found`. A stale screen gets 409: `tournament_not_in_progress`,
`match_has_result` (detail `match_id`), `placement_changed` (a match is not
on the `from_field_id` any more) or `field_not_free` (another match is on
the field now; detail `field_id`, `match_id`). A match whose sides are not
both known, or with a bye, is 422 `match_sides_unknown` (BR-091). Anything
but the four operations of FR-093 (replacing the match on a field, a
rotation) is 422 `placement_not_allowed`.
A player who would be on two fields at once is 422
`player_on_another_field` (BR-131; detail `player_ids`, and `field_ids`,
the fields that would hold them, lowest number first).

delete.description:
Remove a field while the tournament runs; the UI asks first (FR-090, BR-132).

The other fields keep their numbers. The match on the removed field goes
to the front of the waiting list, so it takes the next field that frees
up, or a free one at once.

An unknown field, or a repeated delete, is 404 `field_not_found`: the
field is gone. A tournament not in progress is 409
`tournament_not_in_progress`. The last field is 422 `last_field`.

post.description:
Finish a round robin without a knockout, once the UI has asked (FR-040).

A tournament that is not in progress is 409 `tournament_not_in_progress`
(detail `state`), so a repeat changes nothing. A match without a result is
422 `group_phase_not_done` (detail `matches_left`). A tournament with a
knockout, a Swiss or a Monster DYP is 422 `format_not_supported` for now.
The standings become the places (`GET …/places`).

put.description:
Set the format of a tournament in setup (FR-030, FR-031, FR-039).

A new type keeps the picked players and makes the entries again. A started
tournament is 409 `tournament_not_in_setup`, as for every setup write, so the
points for sitting out cannot change while the phase has a result (BR-075).
Points for sitting out in a round robin are 422
`sit_out_points_not_applicable` (BR-071); BO2 in a league without draws, 422
`draws_not_allowed` (BR-121).

Draw the knockout after the round robin and start it (FR-045).

The best entries of the standings go through as they are, seeded by their
place; entries still level are ordered by lot (BR-074, BR-080, BR-085).
The byes go to the top seeds (BR-040 to BR-042); the first matches take
the free fields, and the round robin's results lock (BR-053).

409: `tournament_not_in_progress` (detail `state`), `current_phase_changed`
(the knockout already exists, detail `current_phase_id`),
`qualifiers_changed` (the cut or the seeds are not the previewed ones,
detail `entry_ids`, the current ones) or `season_closed`. 422:
`format_not_supported` (Swiss, Monster DYP, or no group phase; detail
`format`), `group_phase_not_done` (detail `matches_left`),
`qualifiers_out_of_range` (detail `minimum`, `maximum`, `given`) or
`knockout_mode_not_applicable` (detail `format`).

get.description:
Return the cut, the seeds and the byes the knockout would get (FR-045).

Writes nothing. A knockout that cannot start is still 200, with the
`problem` its start would answer: `tournament_not_in_progress`,
`current_phase_changed` (the knockout exists), `season_closed`,
`format_not_supported` (Swiss, Monster DYP, no group phase),
`group_phase_not_done` or `knockout_mode_not_applicable` (a `mode` after a
round robin).

put.description:
Enter, replace or clear a match's result (FR-050 to FR-053, FR-094).

The body is the whole result, so a repeat changes nothing (ADR-008).
Entering one frees the match's field, which takes the next waiting match
(BR-130, BR-131). The empty result clears it: the match waits again, not
put back on its old field (BR-134), and a finished tournament is back in
progress (BR-095). The free fields are then filled, so the first match that
can be played takes one, the cleared match included.

A closed season is 409 `season_closed`. An unknown match is 404
`match_not_found`. A match whose sides are not both known is 422
`match_sides_unknown` (BR-091). A result that breaks a rule is 422:
`result_does_not_fit_format` (BR-121, detail `format` and `games`),
`draws_not_allowed` (BR-090), `game_score_mismatch` (BR-092, detail
`game_no`) or `scores_required` (Swiss and Monster DYP, detail `game_no`).
A walkover with games is 422 `validation_failed`.

A knockout match after the first round has derived sides: the body names
the entries the screen saw in `expected_sides`. Other entries, or a side
still to come, are 409 `match_sides_changed` (detail `entry_ids`, the
current ones); none is 422 `expected_sides_required`.

The knockout: once it is drawn, a group-phase result is 422
`group_phase_locked` (BR-053, detail `phase_id`); a knockout result that a
later match it feeds has a result for is 422 `result_locked` (BR-094,
detail `match_ids`), and a knockout has no draws (BR-090). A new winner
changes the later matches' sides. The result that completes the
knockout finishes the tournament (FR-037).

delete.description:
Delete the knockout that follows the group phase, with its results (FR-046).

The group phase's results unlock and the organizer chooses again what
comes next (BR-087); a finished tournament is back in progress. The
phase is named by its id: a repeat is 404 `phase_not_found` (ADR-008).
409 `season_closed`. 422 `phase_not_deletable` for a group phase or a
knockout without a group phase (detail `kind`).

get.description:
Return the places and the season points of a finished tournament (§7.13, §7.14).

Computed on read. Before the tournament finishes, `complete` is false and
there are no rows. With a knockout, its entries take the top places and
the others follow in their group-phase order (BR-102, BR-103). A Swiss or
a Monster DYP is 422 `format_not_supported` until they are played.

Return the waiting list, the live standings and whether the group phase is done.

Computed on read (FR-040, FR-060, FR-092). Another league's tournament is
404 `tournament_not_found`.

Return what a finished tournament changed in the season standings (screen 10).

One row per player of the season standings, best first. A tournament that
is not finished contributes nothing yet (BR-112): the list is empty, like
its places. Another league's tournament is 404 `tournament_not_found`.
Return a tournament's setup; another league's tournament is 404.

post.description:
Draw again: a new DYP draw, the rest of Doubles paired, or a shuffle (ADR-010).

A stale `expected_draw_counter` is 409 `draw_counter_changed` with the
current `draw_counter`. Shuffling seeds that come from the ranking is 409
`seeding_method_changed`. A DYP draw needs complete, valid halves: 422
`dyp_halves_incomplete`, `dyp_halves_unequal`, `too_many_left_out` or
`not_enough_players`. Pairing the rest of Doubles with fewer than two
unpaired players is 422 `nothing_to_pair`; nothing changes.

put.description:
Make a DYP tournament's halves by ranking or by hand (FR-033, BR-032).

Once every picked player has a half and the halves are equal, with at most
one left out, the partners are drawn (BR-033). 409 `player_not_picked` and
`tournament_type_changed` as for pairs.

Set a Doubles tournament's pairs (FR-033, BR-003, BR-030).

A player who is not picked is 409 `player_not_picked`; a tournament of
another type is 409 `tournament_type_changed`. Reload on both.

Pick the tournament's players (FR-032).

An id that is not a player of the league is 404 `player_not_found`; a
removed player is 409 `player_removed` (BR-002): reload. A change makes the entries
and draws again, and increments the draw counter (ADR-010).

get.description:
Return what "Generate and start" would create, and write nothing (FR-035).

A tournament that cannot start is still 200 with `can_start` false and the
`problem`: `players_without_partner`, `not_enough_entries`,
`too_many_entries_for_round_robin` (detail `limit`: 64),
`format_not_supported`, the DYP codes of a draw that cannot be made, or
`tournament_not_in_setup` for a started tournament. Another league's
tournament is 404.

put.description:
Reorder the seeds by hand (FR-034).

An order that does not list exactly the current entries is 409
`seed_order_changed`: reload.

Seed by league ranking or by random shuffle (FR-034).

Monster DYP has no seeds: 409 `tournament_type_changed`.

post.description:
Generate the schedule and start the tournament (FR-035).

A round robin gets all its rounds (BR-050 to BR-052), and the first
matches take the fields (BR-130). A started tournament is 409
`tournament_not_in_setup`; a stale `expected_draw_counter` is 409
`draw_counter_changed`. Another format is 422 `format_not_supported` for
now. An incomplete setup is 422: `players_without_partner` (Doubles),
`not_enough_players`, `dyp_halves_incomplete`, `dyp_halves_unequal`,
`too_many_left_out` (DYP), `not_enough_entries` (FR-032) or
`too_many_entries_for_round_robin` (detail `limit`: 64).

get.description: The caller's account; works while a new password is required (ADR-006).

patch.description: Change the display name and the remembered language (FR-081).

get.description:
Return the league of a share link (FR-070).

An unknown token is 404 `share_link_not_found`, with an empty detail.

Return a season's standings from its finished tournaments (FR-070, FR-061).

The same table as the organizer's, with removed players, whose points stay
(BR-002). A season of another league is 404 `season_not_found`.

List a season's tournaments, newest date first, without those in setup.

A season of another league is 404 `season_not_found` (FR-070).

Return a tournament whole: its entries, rounds, results and fields.

A tournament in setup is 404 `tournament_not_found`, like an unknown one or
one of another league (FR-070).

Return a tournament's knockout through the share link (FR-070).

A tournament without a knockout is 404 `knockout_not_found`; one in setup
is 404 `tournament_not_found`, like an unknown one or one of another
league.

Return the places and the season points of a finished tournament (FR-070).

Before the tournament finishes, `complete` is false and there are no rows.
A finished tournament with a knockout is 422 `format_not_supported` until
the knockout is served. A tournament in setup is 404 `tournament_not_found`.

Return a round robin's standings as they are now (FR-060, FR-070).

A tournament in a format without a standings table yet, such as Swiss, has
an empty list. A tournament in setup is 404 `tournament_not_found`, like an
unknown one or one of another league.
